New Horizons photometric model estimating the fraction of sunlight reflected by Charon. Derived from LORRI brightness and scattering assumptions, not a direct bolometric measurement. Gray grid marks missing source cells and uncovered southern latitudes. Colors span 0.1–0.5; values beyond those limits use endpoint colors.
